name: insufficient-stock
description: CORRECTNESS, excluded from the waste benchmark. Eleven identical 600 x 600 panels and one 4x8 sheet. The shortfall is arithmetic rather than a judgement of packing quality: with no edge trim and a 3mm kerf the sheet holds 2 across (600 x 2 + 3 = 1203 of 1220) and 4 down (600 x 4 + 3 x 3 = 2409 of 2440), so exactly 8 fit, with 17mm and 31mm to spare. A third column needs 1806mm and a fifth row 3012mm, so 8 is a hard ceiling and the remaining 3 must be reported exactly.
